title: Pitches from women that identify specific risks, health hazards, or business struggles tend to accelerate funding speed.
Female borrowers who provide detailed personal demographic information may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include a direct thank you to lenders may fund faster.

Pitches from women that focus on personal stories of hardship or narrative-driven appeals are associated with slower funding speeds.

Female borrowers who mention a specific town or city in their pitch fund faster.
